_about: Public-domain William Law (1686-1761, Nonjuror) for the Word Hoard. Ten titles clean from CCEL (A Serious Call, Christian Perfection, the Spirit of Prayer and of Love, the later mystical and controversial works); the Works (Brockenhurst: privately reprinted for G. Moreton, 1892-93, 9 vols; volume numbers read off the title pages) as raw Internet Archive OCR. Not William Law the 19th-century writers, and not his edition of Jacob Boehme. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 4 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
